about_the_game:
In the adventure game Climper Girl on PC, guide the heroine, a champion climber, to find a mysterious artifact. Explore nine levels to get your hands on the coveted relic before your enemies, a sinister secret society, find it first.

Play as the young adventurer and uncover the mysteries of an ancient civilization whose legacy threatens the entire human race.

  • Take part in a unique game that offers not only a captivating adventure, but also a realistic climbing simulation.

  • Discover innovative gameplay thanks to a special engine that allows you to control each of the adventurer's limbs independently.

  • Enjoy a rich game experience that includes exploration, shooting, infiltration, platforming, and various puzzles to solve.

  • Explore a variety of environments (tombs, caves, labyrinths) created by an ancient civilization.

  • Face different enemies in hand-to-hand combat or with your weapons (Beretta, Ingram, USP, AK 47).

  • Progress at your own pace: dare to engage in direct combat or use your climbing skills to move stealthily.
